name: intent
description: Correlator: 'who is talking to whom?' Listens to voice.transcript + gaze.target.resolved on the bus, links speakers to gaze targets via a person store, emits intent.detected.

default_subscriptions.description: Finalised voice utterances from the voice node — fed into the correlator.
Resolved gaze targets from the gaze node — fed into the correlator.
Manually create a person record (voice ↔ gaze ↔ name binding).

name.description: Display name for the person. Defaults to 'Unknown' if omitted.

color.description: Optional UI color (e.g. hex like '#ff8800') for rendering this person.

voice_profile_id.description: Voice profile id to bind to this person, or null if unbound.

gaze_profile_id.description: Gaze profile id to bind to this person, or null if unbound.

id.description: Id of the person record to patch.

voice_profile_id.description: New voice profile id, or null to unbind.

gaze_profile_id.description: New gaze profile id, or null to unbind.
